name: A Grabpack Test [MAP 5]
desc:
Use your Grabpack and get ready to solve puzzles, explore different places and complete maps! Each map has its own challenges, with a mix of puzzle rooms and realistic maps to explore. Heavily inspired by Poppy Playtime.

Thanks to Mob Entertainment for the original game and inspiration!

llm.loop: use the Grabpack hands to solve puzzle rooms -> explore maps with mascot monsters -> complete maps and collect cosmetics
llm.instructions: use your Grabpack to solve puzzles and explore
unique: faithful Poppy Playtime grabpack mechanics as fan game
